title: The Auction Price Puzzle: What Is a Win Worth to Sunrisers Hyderabad?
dek: What does a win cost Sunrisers Hyderabad at the auction table? Dividing recorded squad spend by wins gives a blunt but revealing price.
excerpt: Since 2018, Sunrisers Hyderabad have spent more than the league average per win. Across the league, recorded spend and wins are barely related.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: The Price of a Win
body: Every auction is a bet that money turns into wins. The simplest test divides what a franchise spent on its squad by the matches it won. It ignores prize money and brand value, but it shows how efficiently the money has been converted.
Across 2018–2026, Sunrisers Hyderabad spent {{ev:wc-per}} of recorded squad prices per win, against a league average of {{ev:wc-lg}}. That places them {{ev:wc-rank}} of ten for the cheapest wins.

sections.heading: Money and Wins, League-Wide
body: Across every franchise-season with recorded prices, total spend and wins correlate at {{ev:wc-r}}: they are barely related. Spending more has not reliably bought more wins, which points to how the money is spent rather than how much.
The season chart shows Sunrisers Hyderabad's cost per win year by year; spikes mark seasons where the money bought few results.

sections.heading: Where the Efficiency Comes From
body: Cheap wins usually come from players who outperform their price: retained players bought young, low-priced domestic picks who become regulars, and overseas players chosen to fill a specific role.
The other articles in this aspect break Sunrisers Hyderabad's spending down by tier, retention and nationality to find where that surplus comes from.

sections.heading: Why Spend per Win Is Crude
body: Recorded prices miss some players, and a win in a playoff counts the same as a dead rubber. Spending also buys things that do not show up as wins, from brand value to future seasons.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Money Not Yet Turned Into Wins
body: Sunrisers Hyderabad have converted spend into wins less cheaply than the league average since 2018.
The useful next step is to price each player's contribution, not just the squad's, which the salary-versus-contribution model in this series does.

hypotheses.statement: Hypothesis: part of each season's spend buys future seasons (young players, retentions), so spend per win overstates the cost of current wins.
hypotheses.whyUnverified: Multi-season player value has not been allocated across seasons.
hypotheses.howToTest: Spread each player's price over the seasons they were retained and recompute cost per win.

seo.metaTitle: What is a win worth to SRH at auction?
seo.metaDescription: Sunrisers Hyderabad's recorded squad spend per win since 2018, against every IPL franchise, and why spend and wins are only loosely linked.

methodology: Contribution is tempo runs above average (tRAA): batting runs above what an average batter would score from the same balls in the same season and phase, plus bowling runs saved against the average bowler in the same season and phase. Wickets and dismissals are not valued in this version. Prices come from CricField squad lists (₹ crore = 100 lakh). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Spend per win = sum of recorded season prices ÷ wins in matches with a result.
